name: WiseLending empty-market donation/rounding inflation (second incident)
summary: The attacker reduced the PLP-stETH-Dec2025 lending market to a tiny share base, donated pool tokens, and repeatedly exercised asymmetric deposit/withdraw rounding to inflate the collateral value of a second position, which then borrowed assets from five other WiseLending markets.
notes: The direct WiseLending deployment installed the failure-bearing share-accounting runtime, which remained unchanged through the exploit.

The exploit receipt records the exact gross borrow outflows from WiseLending: 104.066616635764896511 wstETH, 92.012091781801765194 WETH, 9,000 USDC, 2,000 USDT, and 5,000 DAI. The latest CoinGecko WETH and wstETH observations before the transaction plus stablecoin-par valuation produce $565,709.49.
